summary: EF 与 Open Anonymity Project 发布 zkAPI，用零知识证明为付费 API 做匿名额度支付。soispoke 介绍 EIP-8288 下私密、抗量子的转账，Kassandra 主张把隐形地址做成所有钱包都能接入的最小接收标准。规范侧主要是 Glamsterdam 的 BAL（EIP-7928）和 Hegotá 候选 SETCODEFROM（EIP-8298）的细化。

items.title: EF 博客：zkAPI，给任意 API 的私密用量额度
items.note: EF 03:14 在 X 宣布（@ethereumfndn 推文）。用法是往以太坊 vault 存一次额度，再用零知识证明代替身份去授权有上限的用量。文中的例子是私密 AI 推理。
items.title_en: EF Blog: zkAPI, private usage credits for any API
items.note_en: Announced by the EF on X at 03:14 (@ethereumfndn post). You deposit credits into an Ethereum vault once, then authorize bounded usage with zero-knowledge proofs instead of an identity. The example given is private AI inference.

summary_en: The EF and the Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI, which uses zero-knowledge proofs to pay for metered APIs anonymously. soispoke showed private, post-quantum transfers under EIP-8288, and Kassandra argued that stealth addresses should be a minimal receiving standard every wallet can adopt. On the spec side, the work was mostly refining Glamsterdam's BAL (EIP-7928) and SETCODEFROM (EIP-8298), a Hegotá candidate.
